main_measure.name: slope of excess 2-day return on forecast (forecast > 0, non-overlapping grid)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with positive mean excess), t <= -2 rejects; day-clustered t

supporting_check.name: mean excess 2-day return on grid bars with forecast > 0 is above 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the mean excess 2-day return is positive.
reading: Grid at positions 0,2,4,... of each window with a full 2-bar return inside it; normal drift = coin's mean 2-day return over all its grid bars in all windows; regression with intercept, slope t from day-clustered (UTC date of the bar) CR1 standard errors; the plan's 'fewer is inconclusive' minimum is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow rule.
